description: Rank events for the coming weekend (Friday to Sunday local dates) near a saved or given location, using the user's saved interests, followed artists, budget, preferred days and times, and past feedback. Each result says why it was recommended, using only what actually matched. Pass busy intervals from the user's calendar (if the user allowed calendar access in the assistant) to skip conflicts; free/busy is enough, never send event details.
name: get_weekend_recommendations
title: Weekend recommendations
